account_sid.description: The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the Payments resource.

call_sid.description: The SID of the [Call](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/api/call-resource) the Payments resource is associated with. This will refer to the call sid that is producing the payment card (credit/ACH) information thru DTMF.

sid.description: The SID of the Payments resource.

date_created.description: The date and time in GMT that the resource was created specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

date_updated.description: The date and time in GMT that the resource was last updated specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

uri.description: The URI of the resource, relative to `https://api.twilio.com`.
